Travian / standalone farm rotation planner

One farm list. EI or TT.

Pick a built-in village or open your own dump. The origin comes from the first line. Get clay/iron targets nearest-first, trip times and the horses needed to raid each one every 6 minutes.

Troop type — one troop per raid
Fixed interval: 6 minutes. No speed bonuses.

These snapshots are embedded in this HTML. You can move or share this file without the original dumps. Click a village to calculate; switching EI/TT keeps the same targets and distance order.

Use your own dump — open a file or paste its contents
The last two numbers on the first line are X and Y. 
has 15c -106 -6
drthorn spawn: -36 -36
drthorn #2 villa -124 -92
has spawn -87 0

A plain -36 -36 first line also works. Names can contain numbers, such as 15c or #2. The following content must be JSON with a tiles array, or an array of map responses.

Your custom dump stays in this tab. There is no upload, storage service, timer or automatic troop sending.

Choose a built-in village or load a custom dump.

Cumulative horses includes the current row and every row above it. The per-target allocation is the extra rotation capacity needed to add that oasis. You still send one troop per raid, not the entire allocation.

Full add order — closest first

Times are hours:minutes:seconds, rounded for display. Allocations use full-precision round trips. Click a coordinate to open its game details in a new tab; hover over an animal count for species.

Horse budget by radius

How the allocation works

Each target is rounded up separately, then added to the running total. A horse still on its return trip cannot take the next departure. These are ideal rotations without a reserve for losses, delayed returns or other missions.

Coverage & source

Self-contained, local-only calculator. No automatic game requests, farming timers, polling or troop sending. The six-minute interval is only used in the calculation. Map geometry: 401 × 401, wrapping at -200/+200. Wood, crop-only and occupied oases are excluded; mixed clay/crop and iron/crop count once each.
